about_the_game:
💎 MEET MESSALINA!

Welcome to Messalina's House of Pleasures—a place where every desire is fulfilled, every taboo erased, and morality left at the door. Here, they sell touches, moans, and sweet pain wrapped in silk and gemstones. But the true prize isn't the courtesans, the fetish chambers, or the endless kinks—it's Messalina herself: the mistress of the house, sovereign of pleasure, and haunting dream of every soul who once tasted her love... and could never forget.

Messalina doesn't have sex—she conducts it, like a maestro leading a symphony of whips, candles, whispers, and flesh. She can shatter your will with a sigh, drain you with a symphony of orgasms, and reignite you with a single fingertip—on erogenous zones you didn't even know existed. Her voice is sweeter than wine. Her hips are the gateway to paradise. They say one night with Messalina costs a fortune. And yet, not a single soul ever regrets paying it...

📜 WHAT ELSE DO YOU GET?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Messalina as your mascot! You can switch mascots anytime by opening the "Mascot" tab on the home screen.

You'll also receive 10,000 Gold, 100 Rubies and 10 Common Mystic Tomes.

But most importantly—you'll have our heartfelt thanks. Thank you for choosing to support this DLC!
